title: Design, one-pot synthesis, and structural characterization of novel 2-ureido-6-nitrobenzamide derivatives as MTDLs targeting HDAC8/epigenetic-kinase networks.
authors: Farouk, Mahmoud; Mahmoud, Salsabil; Imran, Ahamad; Mahmoud, Sama
one_liner_zh: 该文为小分子药物设计合成与多靶点对接打分研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Modulating intersecting pathological pathways via multi-target directed ligands (MTDLs) is an active frontier in drug discovery. Herein, we report the design, one-pot synthesis, and characterization of a novel series of functionalized 2-ureido-6-nitrobenzamide derivatives 4-8 in 72-82% yields. Sequential nitration and imidization of phthalic anhydride 1, followed by sulfonylation, afforded the N-cyclic imide 2 and its sulfonyl ester building block 3. Aminolysis of 3 using various amines and hydrazines furnished target compounds 4-8 via a base-catalyzed Lossen rearrangement/addition-nucleophile ring-opening (ANRO) cascade. The structures were characterized using NMR, FT-IR, and mass spectrometry. In silico SwissADME analysis predicted favorable drug-like profiles adhering to Lipinski's Rule of Five. To normalized binding free energies, multi-parameter optimization (MPO) workflow utilizing, AutoDock Vina converted raw docking energies (DeltaG(calc)) into calculated logarithmic inhibition constants (pK(i,calc)) across ten targets proteins. The validated and predicted heavy-atom poses closely matched reference structures, with RMSD values confirming docking reliability, while 2D interaction diagrams verified conserved of key contacts. Compound 6 emerged as a prioritized multi-target template, with a balanced predicted dual-target profile against HDAC8 and JNK1. Compound 7 was identified as a prioritized in silico multi-target hit against HDAC8 and PIM1. Structural modifications shifted other derivatives toward target-biased profiles, such as building block 3 against GSK-3beta and compound 8 against JAK2. Overall, these tunable 2-ureido-6-nitrobenzamide scaffold serves as an in silico prioritization starting point for the rational design of dual-action therapeutics targeting complex oncology and neurodegenerative networks, requiring future in vitro and in vivo validation.
abstract_zh: 通过多靶点定向配体（MTDLs）调节交叉病理通路是药物发现中的一个活跃前沿领域。在此，我们报告了一系列功能化2-脲基-6-硝基苯甲酰胺衍生物4-8的设计、一锅法合成及表征，产率为72-82%。邻苯二甲酸酐1依次进行硝化和酰亚胺化，随后进行磺酰化，得到N-环状酰亚胺2及其磺酰酯构建模块3。使用各种胺和肼对3进行氨解，通过碱催化的Lossen重排/加成-亲核开环（ANRO）级联反应得到目标化合物4-8。结构通过NMR、FT-IR和质谱进行表征。计算机模拟SwissADME分析预测了符合Lipinski五规则的良好类药特性。为归一化结合自由能，采用多参数优化（MPO）工作流程，利用AutoDock Vina将原始对接能量（DeltaG(calc)）转换为跨十个靶蛋白的计算对数抑制常数（pK(i,calc)）。验证和预测的重原子姿态与参考结构紧密匹配，RMSD值确认了对接可靠性，而2D相互作用图验证了关键接触的保守性。化合物6成为优先的多靶点模板，对HDAC8和JNK1具有平衡的预测双靶点特性。化合物7被确定为针对HDAC8和PIM1的优先计算机模拟多靶点命中物。结构修饰使其他衍生物转向靶点偏向性特征，如构建模块3针对GSK-3beta和化合物8针对JAK2。总体而言，这种可调谐的2-脲基-6-硝基苯甲酰胺骨架作为计算机模拟优先排序的起点，为针对复杂肿瘤和神经退行性网络的合理设计双作用治疗药物提供基础，需未来进行体外和体内验证。
